label: Note
description: A short text post — the fediverse-canonical Note.

parts.label: content
parts.description: The note text. May contain HTML in fediverse usage.

parts.label: summary
parts.description: Optional short summary or content warning.

parts.label: published
parts.description: ISO-8601 datetime the note was published.

parts.label: updated
parts.description: ISO-8601 datetime of the most recent edit.

parts.label: attributedTo
parts.description: The author — Person or Actor reference.

parts.label: inReplyTo
parts.description: Optional reference to the Note this is a reply to.

parts.label: to
parts.description: Audience the note is addressed to (often urn:solid:Public for public posts).
